title: Nature Collage — God's Beautiful Outdoors
memory_verse: "The heavens declare the glory of God." — Psalm 19:1
objective: Students will collect natural items and create a collage to appreciate the beauty of God's creation.
content: God filled the world with so many beautiful things! Leaves, flowers, sticks, and rocks are all gifts from God. Each one is special and unique.
When we go outside, we can find treasures that God made. A soft leaf, a bumpy stick, a smooth stone — God designed each one with care.
We can take the things we find and glue them onto paper to make a nature collage. A collage is a picture made from many different pieces. It is a beautiful way to say 'Thank You, God!'
activity: Go outside and collect leaves, small sticks, flower petals, and pebbles. Glue them onto a piece of paper or cardboard to make a nature collage. Write or say 'God made it all!' when you are finished.
discussion: Which item from nature is your favorite?
How does going outside help us see what God made?
